label: Identity spelling census: six families — kebab prefixed sk-code-opencode (primary), kebab bare code-opencode (live routing id + changelog alias), spaced lowercase 'sk code opencode' (generated retrieval artifacts only), snake CODE_OPENCODE_DIR (packet script), camel codeOpencode (packet script), qualified sk-code:code-opencode (history token).

The bare form code-opencode is a live alias/id family: .skilled/changelog/sk-code/code-opencode symlinks to ../../skills/sk-code/sk-code-opencode/changelog (siblings code-quality/code-review/code-webflow/code-obsidian follow the same convention), and hub-router.json carries code-opencode-aliases/-runtime/-authoring classes plus benchmark route tokens 'route / [code-opencode]'.

Live snake/camel identifiers are confined to the packet's own scripts (rename-with-packet): CODE_OPENCODE_DIR in run-all-drift-guards.sh:23 and codeOpencode in verify-router-sync.cjs:261; the history-quoted CODE_OPENCODE test constant and compareAuditCodeOpenCodePenalty have no live carrier under .skilled (complete 14-match live sweep).

Exclusion corpus: .opencode/ is the runtime alias dir (live markers in review-research-paths.cjs:70, vitest configs); cli-opencode is a live child skill of cli-external-orchestration (permission-request-policy.mjs:53, trigger-index.json:316, ai-council seat filenames); standalone opencode/OpenCode/OPENCODE is runtime brand/command/surface token (runtime ids, 'opencode run', OPENCODE surface token).

Match-pattern rules: SAFE = exact sk-code-opencode; boundary-anchored (^|[^k_-])(?:sk-)?code-opencode; family alternation sk[_-]?code[_-]?opencode|code[_-]?opencode|codeopencode|'sk code opencode' (all identity variants carry 'code' before 'opencode'). UNSAFE = bare opencode token, -opencode suffix, .opencode segment, OPENCODE alone. Path rewrites must be segment-scoped so .opencode segments survive; changelog symlinks re-point; hub-router classes/leaf ids are routing-layer rename targets.

Residual: uppercase-kebab and mixed-separator forms were not isolated by this iteration's sweeps (kebab shapes excluded by construction); no observed carrier suggests they exist, and iteration 2's case-insensitive family sweep (2,378 files) bounds them; no live Pascal carrier for CodeOpenCode remains.

Rename match patterns must anchor on 'code-opencode' (with optional 'sk-' prefix); the bare 'opencode' substring is shared with .opencode/ and cli-opencode and must never be the match key; path rewrites are segment-scoped.

direction: Treating standalone `opencode`/`OpenCode`/`OPENCODE` as an identity spelling to rename
reason: Live corpus shows it is exclusively the runtime brand/command/surface token (runtime ids, `opencode run`, OPENCODE surface token); only code-bearing forms (sk-code-opencode, code-opencode and derived identifiers) are identity.
